in_sanskrit.name: व्यस्थ्यश्वान्श
in_sanskrit.meaning: Speech of the God of Health
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The speech or discourse of the God of Health and Wellbeing, Vayu (Wind) or Indra (Rain) who are believed to maintain the health and vitality of the body.

in_marathi.name: Bhashkvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Speech of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhashkvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhashkvansh is derived from Sanskrit words 'Bhash' meaning speech and 'Kvansh' meaning God's creation. This name is believed to be a divine name that signifies the power of speech and the wisdom of God. It is a name that embodies the essence of divine communication and is highly revered in Hindu mythology.
